run_booktest_teacher: run the DefaultTeacher to load and serve BookTest dialog data for training
build_booktest_dataset: build the BookTest dataset by calling the build function to download data files
get_booktest_data_path: get the BookTest data file path for train, valid, or test splits using _path
review_defaultteacher_init: review the DefaultTeacher class init to understand how opt and datafile are configured
test_booktest_streaming: test the DefaultTeacher with streaming mode by setting datatype to stream
